h1: Secure business storage with full item tracking
lead: BRS stores your boxes, files and equipment in a managed facility and tracks the movement and access history of every item. Storage that fits around your move.
card_blurb: Secure storage with software that tracks the movement and access history of every item.
meta_description: Secure storage for business files, equipment and furniture, with software tracking of every item's movement and access history. Request a quote from BRS.
overview: Business Relocation Services (BRS) offers secure storage for companies that need somewhere safe to keep property during a move, a renovation or a longer transition. Our facility lets us track, manage and secure your most important items.
Tracking software records the movement and access history of every box, file or item you place in our care. You always know what is stored, where it is and who has accessed it.
Storage works alongside our moving services, so items can go from your office to the facility and back again under one plan.

benefits.title: Security you can verify
benefits.text: Security is the most important factor in a storage facility. Our focus is on protecting what you entrust to us and giving you confidence in how it is handled.

benefits.title: Every item tracked
benefits.text: Our software records the movement and access history of each box, file or item. Nothing is stored without a record.

benefits.title: Flexible storage options
benefits.text: We offer flexible moving and storage options, so you can fit storage to your project instead of the other way round.

included: Secure storage in a large, managed facility
Software tracking of each box, file or item
Movement and access history for everything stored
Storage for boxes, files and other business property
Coordination with your move, so items travel and return under one plan

process.title: Plan the storage
process.text: We review what needs to be stored, for how long and when it will be needed again.

process.title: Move and log items
process.text: Items are moved to the facility and entered in our tracking software.

process.title: Store and monitor
process.text: We keep your property secure and record any movement or access.

process.title: Return on schedule
process.text: When you are ready, we bring items back to your new space as part of the move.

who_for: Companies mid-move that need a temporary home for equipment
Organizations that need a record of who accessed stored files
Businesses holding furniture or equipment between locations
Corporations, city agencies, non-profits and schools

faq.q: How do you keep track of what is stored?
faq.a: We use software that records the movement and access history of every box, file or item you entrust to us.

faq.q: Can storage be combined with a move?
faq.a: Yes. We offer flexible moving and storage options, so storage can be planned as part of your relocation.
Request a quote online or call 1-718-399-8000. Our offices are in Secaucus, NJ and New York, NY.
